    8,5/10

    The ROG Xbox Ally is undoubtedly the PC console that goes the furthest in its attempt to combine the Windows universe with mobile gaming. Its ergonomics, performance and, above all, its Xbox interface designed for touchscreen and controller use make all the difference. ... It is a good entry point into the world of Xbox-style portable PC gaming... .

    Thêm

  • MaisonetDomotique.com

    8,1/10

    The ROG Xbox Ally succeeds in its goal: offering AAA gaming on the go with an experience close to that of an Xbox, thanks to the Ryzen Z2 A, the 7" 120 Hz screen and the Game Pass ecosystem on Windows 11 in full-screen mode. Performance is on point, heat dissipation is under control, and connectivity (including Thunderbolt 4) opens the door to docking and even eGPU. ... For those who want a ‘console PC’ without compromising on power, the Xbox Ally is the obvious choice.
